setup_command: CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3 && pnpm run build
launch_command: node --import tsx scripts/upgrade-state.ts set && node dist/index.js
probe_command: node --input-type=module -e "const {OneCLI}=await import('@onecli-sh/sdk'); const client=new OneCLI({url:'http://127.0.0.1:' + process.env.CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT, apiKey:'clawgap-loopback-mock'}); const config=await client.getContainerConfig(); if (!config.env || config.env.CLAWGAP_ENVIRONMENT !== 'ready') process.exit(1);"
